title: Batched Stochastic Linear Bandits with 1-Bit Communication Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2605.30976v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study stochastic linear bandits under a natural combination of batching and communication constraints: the time horizon is partitioned into batches of equal size $B$, and during each batch the learner sends $B$ requested arm pulls to an agent, who then observes the corresponding $B$ rewards and responds with a single bit of feedback to the learner. For each batch, the learner specifies the 1-bit quantization rule the agent uses, which may depend on all previously received bits but not on any past rewards directly. This setting addresses a significant yet unexplored ``middle ground'' between previous models having per-round quantization only or total bit budgets only. We establish a minimax lower bound showing that $\Omega(B\min\{d,\log\lvert \mathcal{A} \rvert\})$ regret is unavoidable due to the 1-bit communication bottleneck, even in the absence of noise. translated_title: 具有1比特通信约束的批式随机线性老虎机
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在批处理与通信约束的一种自然组合下的随机线性老虎机问题：整个时间范围被划分为大小均为 $B$ 的批次，在每个批次中，学习者向代理发送 $B$ 个所请求的动作拉取，代理随后观测相应的 $B$ 个奖励，并向学习者反馈仅一个比特的信息。对于每个批次，学习者指定代理所使用的1比特量化规则，该规则可以依赖于之前接收到的所有比特，但不能直接依赖于任何过去的奖励。这一设置填补了以往仅考虑逐轮量化模型与仅有总比特预算模型之间一个重要但尚未被探索的“中间地带”。我们建立了一个极小极大下界，表明由于1比特通信瓶颈，即使在没有噪声的情况下，$\Omega(B\min\{d,\log\lvert \mathcal{A} \rvert\})$ 的遗憾也是不可避免的。结合标准的统计极限，这得到一个一般的低……
tldr: 该论文首次研究了批处理与1比特通信约束相结合的随机线性老虎机问题，并证明了即使在无噪声环境下，1比特通信瓶颈也会导致 $\Omega(B\min\{d,\log|\mathcal{A}|\})$ 的不可避免的遗憾下界。
en_tdlr: This paper studies stochastic linear bandits under a natural combination of batching and 1-bit communication constraints, and establishes a minimax lower bound showing that $\Omega(B\min\{d,\log|\mathcal{A}|\})$ regret is unavoidable due to the 1-bit communication bottleneck even in the absence of noise.
